meta_description:
40 likes, 9 comments - mombae.blogger on October 31, 2026: "The moment my kids get back from school, it’s usually a quick change, a snack and off they go again for their extracurricular classes! 😅

Between swimming, skating, football, cricket and everything else, their evenings are packed.

So I always try to keep an after-school snack ready for them — something filling and nutritious that keeps them going until dinner.

I make things like cutlets, tikkis, chaat, and other little snacks that pack in some extra nutrition.

One thing I’ve also added to their after-school routine is @our.littlejoys Nutrimix 7+. It’s a milk mix for children made with ingredients like ragi, bajra, almonds and walnuts, naturally sweetened with jaggery and dates. Two scoops provide 9g of protein, along with essential vitamins and minerals like calcium, vitamin A, vitamin C and DHA.

Comment NUTRIMIX & I’ll send you a link

I also appreciate that every pack has a QR code through which parents can access lab reports and check protein validation, heavy metal and mineral testing. And thankfully, the kids love the taste!

If you’re also looking for ideas to make snacking a little more nutritious, Comment SNACKS & I’ll send you a list.

#AfterSchoolSnacks #HealthySnacksForKids #VegetarianKids".
